85804788791db565.column_purpose: Whether the card is a story spotlight card (tied to the set's narrative).

1155164183495691.column_purpose: Card layout type: normal, split, transform, modal_dfc, adventure, leveler, augment, scheme, etc.

ed74b295eeb08a9d.column_purpose: Serialized flags for which formats the card can be a commander in: brawl, commander, oathbreaker.

1c884507e964e656.column_purpose: Starting life total modifier, used only by Vanguard cards.

ee4e07ff6dbb0e20.column_purpose: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. {1}{W}, {R/G}{R/G}; null for lands and face-up cards with no cost.

ae9bb95b98b97f8d.column_purpose: Cardmarket meta-product ID (grouping of printings of the same card across sets).

8b6cd3b4c9ccc956.column_purpose: MTG Arena internal card ID, present only for cards available on Arena.

7476ffd5b0a243bd.column_purpose: MTGO catalog ID for the non-foil version of this printing on Magic Online.

1539699c063cd275.column_purpose: Creature power as printed; stored as text because values can be variable ('*', '2+*').

7d766e136dceb67d.column_purpose: Comma-separated list of set codes in which this card (by name) has ever been printed.

ea8534c884916bca.column_purpose: Scryfall oracle ID, shared by all printings of the same card (same name/rules text) across sets.

c8601698b7021de3.column_purpose: Date the ruling was issued (2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05).

d83ddcd38b53b24c.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for each ruling.

234cc402c17c375d.column_purpose: Official ruling text explaining how the card's ability/interaction works.

e54c40b069d45af1.column_purpose: The set's name translated into the given language (e.g. 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Italian for 'Return to Ravnica', '미로딘 포위전' = Korean for 'Mirrodin Besieged'). 1c4f9dec6afe96ff.column_purpose: Number of distinct cards in the set excluding variants (base set size, as in MTGJSON); 0 for sets with no cards.

3542870dfbf7ad1f.column_purpose: Name of the Magic block the set belongs to (e.g. 'Theros', 'Shadows over Innistrad') or a grouping label for non-blocked sets (e.g. 'Core Set', 'Commander', 'Judge Gift Cards'). Null for sets not part of a block.

9e5bd5fcfb086299.column_purpose: JSON string describing booster pack composition per booster type (e.g. 'default', 'arena'): number of commons, uncommons, rares/mythics, lands, etc. Null for sets without booster packs (promos, memorabilia).

af5919b1ba68e860.column_purpose: Unique short code identifying the set (e.g. 'TSP' = Time Spiral, '10E' = Tenth Edition). Referenced by cards.setCode and set_translations.setCode.

36fb5d2e74fb90d9.column_purpose: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for the set row.

c1f08b573f58a8dc.column_purpose: 1 if all cards in the set exist only in foil version, else 0.

ab98fd4ffc58980a.column_purpose: 1 if the set exists only in digital form (MTGO/Arena), else 0.

5314d73689435dbf.column_purpose: 1 if the set is only a partial preview of an upcoming set, else 0.

061a1b7a07d52c26.column_purpose: Name of the set as listed on Cardmarket (MCM); null when not listed there.

6819248f2ab2a37f.column_purpose: Set code as used by Magic: The Gathering Online (may differ from the main set code); null for sets not available on MTGO.

f5ac9ec948d103b7.column_purpose: Set code of the parent set this set belongs to (e.g. a promo set tied to an expansion); null for standalone sets.

8fc65481d791ef7a.column_purpose: Release date of the set (YYYY-MM-DD), ranging from 1993-08-05 (Alpha) to 2021-03-19.

8282122fbb28d121.column_purpose: TCGplayer group (category) ID for the set; null when the set is not sold on TCGplayer.

1f78217704077130.column_purpose: Total number of distinct cards in the set including variants (always >= baseSetSize).
